title: Replika founder raises $20M pre-seed for Wabi, the ‘YouTube of apps’
description: Wabi, a startup from the founder of Replika, has just raised a $20 million pre-seed round. Wabi is like "YouTube for apps" -- a social platform where anyone can use prompts to instantly create mini apps and share them with friends.
author: Ivan Mehta, Rebecca Bellan

title: Google makes it easier to access AI Mode in Chrome on iOS and Android
description: Users will now be able to access AI Mode via a new dedicated shortcut button under the search bar when opening a "New Tab" page in Chrome.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Microsoft built a fake marketplace to test AI agents — they failed in surprising ways
description: The research raises new questions about how well AI agents will perform when working unsupervised — and how quickly AI companies can make good on promises of an agentic future.
author: Russell Brandom

title: This startup’s metal stacks could help solve AI’s massive heat problem
description: Alloy Enterprises has developed a new additive manufacturing technique that can improve liquid cooling performance while bringing it to new parts of the server rack.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Google gets the US government’s green light to acquire Wiz for $32B
description: Google announced its intent to acquire cloud security company Wiz in March and the deal is now on track to close in early 2026.
author: Rebecca Szkutak
